title: Browser registry tests skip on any browser import failure
reasoning: The suite treats every ImportError raised while importing execute_browser as meaning Playwright is unavailable, then skips the whole browser registration class. That also skips tests when the browser tool itself is broken by a missing internal module, bad relative import, or packaging regression, which is exactly the kind of release hazard these registry tests should catch.
recommendation: Only skip when the missing dependency is specifically Playwright, for example by using pytest.importorskip for the Playwright dependency before importing the Windie browser tool, or by inspecting the ImportError name/path and re-raising unrelated import failures.
whyTestsDoNotAlreadyCoverThis: The skip condition is evaluated before any tests run, so unrelated browser import failures prevent all assertions in this file from executing.
suggestedRegressionTest: Add a test or import guard path that proves an ImportError from tools.browser.browser_tool or one of WindieOS's own modules is not converted into a skip.
